title: Invoker Patch
description: Makes the Invoker from Illager Invasion not immune to magic damage
body:
This addon only makes the Invoker from Illager Invasion not immune to magic damage but instead take 
``` 
damage * multiplier = damage done
```
The multiplier base is ```0.5``` but you can also change it inside 
```
config/invoker_patch.properties
```

Great for mods that gives the player many ways to deal ```MAGIC``` damage.

Depends on ```Illager Invasion```
